command.zephyrium.profile.hover.verdict:
HEALTHY: ticks under 25 ms and under 1%% of entity ticks skipped.
BUSY: ticks under 45 ms and under 5% skipped.
OVERLOADED: anything worse.
command.zephyrium.profile.hover.server: Ticks per second and the server thread's time per tick.
command.zephyrium.profile.hover.entities:
CPU per entity tick counts the carrier threads, the server thread's entity loop and the tasks entities sent to it. Compare it with entityProcesses off.
Skipped: ticks dropped because the entity was still busy with the previous one.
command.zephyrium.profile.hover.cpu: Cores used on average by the whole JVM, the server thread and the carrier threads, then memory allocated per entity tick and garbage collection time.
command.zephyrium.profile.hover.waits: Time the server thread spent blocked on entity processes.
